title: Normalized braided derived restriction for fixed tensor localizations
statement: For a ring-sheaf isomorphism a:R≅S, any ordinary normalized inverse restriction transport, and simultaneous symmetric derived tensors with lax braided localizations having invertible unit and K-flat-second tensorators, the canonical exact derived inverse restriction admits a strong braided structure. Its canonical factorization Q_R⋙D(T_a)≅Ch(T_a)⋙Q_S is monoidal for the given ordinary and termwise tensor comparisons. Dependencies: [lem-sfb-ring-isomorphism-tensor-transport], [lem-pur-u2-normalized-braided-localization], [lem-pc-kflat-resolution].

lean.statement:
theorem ringIso_normalized_derived_braided (a : R ≅ S)
    (o : RingIsoTensorTransport a.symm)
    (qR : (DerivedCategory.Q (C := scalarModules J R)).LaxBraided)
    (qS : (DerivedCategory.Q (C := scalarModules J S)).LaxBraided)
    (hεR : IsIso qR.toLaxMonoidal.ε) (hεS : IsIso qS.toLaxMonoidal.ε)
    (hμR : ∀ P Q : CochainComplex (scalarModules J R) ℤ,
      Q.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients → IsIso (qR.toLaxMonoidal.μ P Q))
    (hμS : ∀ P Q : CochainComplex (scalarModules J S) ℤ,
      Q.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients → IsIso (qS.toLaxMonoidal.μ P Q)) :
    ∃ b : (scalarRestriction a.inv).mapDerivedCategory.Braided,
      letI : (scalarRestriction a.inv).Monoidal := o.monoidal.toMonoidal
      letI : (scalarRestriction a.inv).IsEquivalence :=
        o.functor_eq ▸ o.equivalence.isEquivalence_functor
      letI := qR
      letI := qS
      letI := b
      letI := Functor.mapCochainComplexMonoidal (scalarRestriction a.inv)
      NatTrans.IsMonoidal (scalarRestriction a.inv).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom
